interpretation: Manager revision input to P-F.0.3.

interpretation: Explicit approval control, separate from revision.

name: Delivery Information
interpretation: Aggregate response includes order association, confirmation and delivery context.

name: Supplier Confirmation Record
interpretation: Retained supplier-response event and associated recorded state.

name: Updated Order Status
interpretation: Internal state to presentation then external status.

name: Order Status Information
